title: Waymo's autonomous driving technology navigates a police controlled intersection
summary: A Waymo clip, sped up 3x, showing its autonomous car stopping at a broken traffic light and proceeding on a police officer's hand signals.
why: HN cites it as evidence that self-driving cars can obey traffic cops, though some call the scenario idealized.
